title: Message as the recipient sees it
description: The minimum that the recipient's model sees (and code through msg.receive): a handle for replying, type, genus, sender role, time, subject, fields and the note in the untrusted text wrapper (INJ-4), the untrusted flag. The recipient does not see the tenant, the worker id, the initiators, tracing or correlation (MSG-8). The state genus also has the stale mark (MSG-12).

handle.description: Handle of the inbox entry that the core gave to this attempt: an opaque string, used to reply (reply_to) and to return the entry. The ids of the entry, the worker and the tenant are not visible in it.

fields.description: Fields by the closed schema of the type.

note.description: Note inside the untrusted text wrapper (INJ-4).

stale.description: Only for the state genus: the value is older than the type's stale_after.
